id: title:VojtechBartos:resolve the agent design gate against the acting user

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Slack App agent-design gate resolving against PostHog user identity, supporting tiered or personalized feature availability.
review.reason: Adds Slack App agent-design gate resolving against PostHog user identity, supporting tiered or personalized feature availability.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on supplied observations; no independent verification of actual rollout behavior or tier enforcement. No tier assignment requested.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.

observations.behavior: Adds a Slack App agent-design gate that resolves against a PostHog user identity rather than the Slack workspace, and its supporting implementation and tests.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog's internal rollout rules (e.g., email, cohort) to apply to the Slack App agent-design feature, rather than treating the Slack workspace as the identity. This could support tiered or personalized feature availability for Slack App users.
